description: Unit test for the NullAttributes class, verifying immutability, JSON representation, equality, and behavior of null attribute objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: NullAttributesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the NullAttributes implementation, focusing on immutability, JSON representation, and equality checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with an instance of NullAttributes created via NullAttributes.newInstance().

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that NullAttributes instances are immutable and that JsonObject used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods for NullAttributes using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the null attributes object reports itself as empty.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsJsonNull
methods.description: Asserts that the object reports itself as null in JSON terms.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsJsonObject
methods.description: Asserts that the object reports itself as a JSON object.

methods.name: nullAttributesAsJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that asObject() returns the JSON null object representation.

methods.name: createInstanceReturnsTheExpectedJson
methods.description: Ensures that toJsonString() outputs the string 'null'.

methods.name: nullAttributesIsNothing
methods.description: Confirms that the attribute does not identify as boolean, number, string, or array.
